chunks: Hadith 4858 — Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, who said:
ʿAbbād al-Baṣrī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, while I was present with him, “How does a man perform liʿān against a woman?” So he عليه السلام said:

A man from among the Muslims came to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and said: “O Messenger of Allah, what do you say if a man enters his house and sees with his wife a man having intercourse with her—what would he do concerning them?”
He said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله turned away from him, so the man departed. That man was the very one who had been afflicted with that matter concerning his wife.
He said: Then revelation came down from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, with the ruling concerning them.

He said: So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله sent for that man and summoned him, and said: “Are you the one who saw a man with your wife?” He said: “Yes.” So he said to him: “Go and bring me your wife, for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has sent down the ruling concerning you and her.”

He said: Her husband brought her, and the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله made her stand and said to the husband: “Bear witness four testimonies by Allah that you are surely among the truthful regarding what you have accused her of.”

He said: So he testified. He said: Then the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “Stop,” and admonished him. Then he said to him: “Have taqwa of Allah, for the curse of Allah is severe.” Then he said: “Bear the fifth testimony that the curse of Allah be upon you if you are among the liars.”

He said: So he testified. Then he ordered that he be moved aside. Then he عليه السلام said to the woman: “Bear witness four testimonies by Allah that your husband is surely among the liars regarding what he has accused you of.”

He said: So she testified. He said: Then he said to her: “Stop,” and admonished her. Then he said to her: “Have taqwa of Allah, for the anger of Allah is severe.” Then he said to her: “Bear the fifth testimony that the anger of Allah be upon you if your husband is among the truthful regarding what he has accused you of.”
He said: So she testified. He said: Then he separated them and said to them: “Do not ever come together again in marriage after you have performed liʿān.”

key_terms.الْحُكْمَ: the legal ruling revealed for their case
key_terms.بِنِكَاحٍ: marriage bond; here, reunion in marriage is forbidden
key_terms.غَضَبَ: the anger of Allah invoked in the woman’s fifth testimony
key_terms.فَفَرَّقَ: he separated them legally after liʿān
key_terms.لَعْنَةَ: the curse of Allah invoked upon lying
key_terms.يُلَاعِنُ: to invoke mutual imprecation between spouses

ai.seo_question: How is liʿān performed between a husband and wife in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the procedure of liʿān, in which a husband and wife invoke solemn testimonies and divine curse or غضب when the husband accuses his wife of adultery and lacks ordinary proof. It shows that the ruling was established through revelation and implemented by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, resulting in permanent separation after mutual imprecation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4858 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdul Rahman ibn Al-Hajjaj who said:
Abbad Al-Basri asked Abu Abdullah (as), while I was present with him, "How does a man invoke the mutual imprecation (li'an) against his wife?"

Imam (as) replied: "A man from among the Muslims came to the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) and said: 'O Messenger of Allah (swt), what do you say about a man who enters his house and finds another man with his wife, engaged in intercourse, what should he do about them?'
The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) turned away from him, and the man left. That man was, in fact, the one who had been afflicted with this situation concerning his wife.
Then, revelation descended from Allah (swt), the Almighty, with the ruling regarding their case.

The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) sent for the man and called him.
He (sw) said to him: 'Are you the one who saw a man with your wife?'
He replied: 'Yes.'
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) then said: 'Go and bring your wife to me, for Allah (swt), the Almighty, has revealed the ruling concerning you and her.'"

The husband brought his wife, and the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) had her stand before him (sw).
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to the husband: "Bear witness four times by Allah (swt) that you are among the truthful in what you have accused her of."

The man testified accordingly.
Then the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Pause," and He (sw) admonished him, saying, "Fear Allah (swt), for the curse of Allah (swt) is severe."
He (sw) then instructed him: "Now bear witness the fifth time that the curse of Allah (swt) is upon you if you are among the liars."

The man testified the fifth time.
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) then ordered that the man be set aside and turned to the woman, saying: "Bear witness four times by Allah (swt) that your husband is among the liars in what he has accused you of."

She testified accordingly.
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) then said: "Pause," and He (sw) admonished her, saying, "Fear Allah (swt), for the anger of Allah (swt) is severe."
He (sw) then told her: "Now bear witness the fifth time that the anger of Allah (swt) is upon you if your husband is among the truthful in what he has accused you of."

She testified the fifth time.
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) then separated them and said: "You two can never be joined together in marriage again after you have both engaged in liʿan."
